attack_parameters.description: Scenario 7 includes two flying sub-scenarios with no jamming. (1) 2.3.15 (Helicopter, route 2) uses GPS L1/L2/L5 + Galileo E1/E5 at 0.316 W, starting over the sea 1 km north (Midnattskjæran) at 200 m HAE. (2) 2.3.12 (Drone, route 4) uses GPS L1 C/A only at 0.316 W, starting at 69.277014014, 15.969328354, 40 m HAE. Spoofing transmissions are corrected for signal delay to ensure coherent signals at the victim aircraft’s position. All start times are referenced to live GPS signals.
